atoms.a: First off all, we visited the Burj Khalifa, and it was absolutely astonishing. We went up to the observation deck and the view of the city from up there was mind-blowing. Some of our classmates passed on this experience because of their fear of heights. They watched the Palm Fountain instead, a water fountain show in front of the Burj Khalifa.

We also checked out the Dubai Mall and did some shopping. It's seriously gigantic. Even those students who usually don't enjoy shopping in malls had a nice time. Everyone bought some souvenirs for their friends and families.

Another fun activity was the desert safari we went on. Riding through the sand dunes was so much fun. We even got to try sandboarding. Yes, you heard me right. We didn't go snowboarding, but sandboarding.

And of course, we couldn't leave without visiting the Palm Jumeirah. It is an island created in the shape of a palm tree. At the beach, we went for a walk, played beach volleyball and swam in the ocean.
